result.summary: The pedestrian environment is hostile, featuring a lack of marked crossings and significant debris obstructing the roadside. While a narrow sidewalk exists on the right, the overall infrastructure is degraded and prioritizes vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Roadside Debris
hazards.description: Large amounts of trash and debris on the left shoulder force pedestrians into the active travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway along the shoulder

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: No designated crossing points are visible, increasing risk for pedestrians attempting to cross the two-lane road.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire roadway foreground

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction and Degradation
hazards.description: The existing sidewalk on the right is narrow, cracked, and partially obstructed by utility poles.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction and Repair
interventions.description: Install a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on both sides of the street to provide safe separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks and pedestrian warning signs to designate safe crossing locations.

interventions.title: Debris Removal and Maintenance
interventions.description: Clear the accumulated trash and debris from the roadside to reclaim walking space.

result.summary: The image depicts an urban intersection with sidewalks but a complete lack of marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals. While the environment includes street trees and lighting, pedestrians must cross an unmarked roadway where parked vehicles may obstruct sightlines.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or prioritized path.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the corner of the intersection may block the view between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sides of the intersection along the curb

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install ladder or zebra-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: This industrial corridor lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks and marked crossings, creating a hostile environment for people walking. A marked bike lane is present but is significantly obstructed by piles of trash bags and temporary barriers, further compromising safety for non-motorized users.

hazards.name: Debris and Trash Obstruction
hazards.description: Large black trash bags are piled in the bike lane and shoulder area, forcing users into the travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Facilities
hazards.description: No dedicated, separated space for pedestrians exists, forcing them into the roadway or onto unpaved, overgrown shoulders.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street throughout the corridor

hazards.name: Temporary Barrier Obstruction
hazards.description: An orange plastic barrier is placed in the shoulder/bike lane area, creating a physical obstacle for non-motorized users.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the road near the trash bags

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk separated from the roadway to provide a safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Install physical separators such as bollards or curbs to prevent debris accumulation and vehicle encroachment in the bike lane.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks and pedestrian warning signage to facilitate safe crossing of the roadway.

result.summary: The environment is extremely hostile for pedestrians, characterized by a complete lack of dedicated walkways and massive piles of illegally dumped debris blocking the paved shoulder. Dense, unmanaged vegetation further restricts visibility and usable space, forcing any pedestrians into the active roadway.

hazards.name: Illegal Dumping and Debris
hazards.description: Large piles of trash, construction debris, and household items completely block the paved shoulder, forcing pedestrians into traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side and center foreground

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: No sidewalk or protected walkway is provided, leaving pedestrians exposed to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible roadway edge

interventions.title: Debris Removal and Site Remediation
interventions.description: Immediate removal of all illegally dumped materials and implementation of deterrents like fencing or lighting to prevent future dumping.
